post_topic: Shipping CAN-SPAM compliance into the Micro SaaS Engine's outreach system before anything else
image_description:
Single standalone diagram. One concept only. No panels, no grids, no collages. Full bleed 1080x1080px white background.

Title at top in bold sans-serif: "CAN-SPAM Compliance Gate — Micro SaaS Engine Outreach"

A single left-to-right linear flow diagram with five nodes connected by arrows.

Node 1 (leftmost, navy rectangle): Label "Outreach Engine" with a small envelope icon. Arrow pointing right labeled "Initiate Send".

Node 2 (navy rectangle): Label "Suppression List Check". Sub-label in smaller text: "Is recipient suppressed?". Two arrows exit: one downward labeled "Yes → Drop" leading to a small amber stop-sign shape labeled "Send Blocked"; one rightward labeled "No → Continue".

Node 3 (navy rectangle): Label "Unsubscribe Endpoint Validation". Sub-label: "One-click link present and resolvable?". Two arrows exit: one downward labeled "No → Drop" to another amber stop-sign labeled "Send Blocked"; one rightward labeled "Yes → Continue".

Node 4 (navy rectangle): Label "Physical Address Gate". Sub-label: "Real mailing address in template?". Two arrows exit: one downward labeled "No → Hard Stop" to a larger amber stop-sign labeled "Send Blocked — Hard Gate"; one rightward labeled "Yes → Cleared".

Node 5 (rightmost, blue #5a96ff rectangle): Label "Email Sends" with a checkmark icon.

All three "Send Blocked" shapes are amber #F5A623. Main flow arrows are navy. The Hard Gate stop-sign is slightly larger than the others to indicate emphasis. Nodes are evenly spaced horizontally. Clean minimal connectors.

Navy #0A0F1E primary elements, blue #5a96ff highlights, amber #F5A623 callouts and important labels. Clean sans-serif font. Real cloud provider logos where relevant. Small text "Kelvin Davis" bottom right corner. Professional LinkedIn infographic style similar to ByteByteGo. White background. No dark backgrounds.
